Article id: configure-online-appointment-booking
Article: Set up and manage online appointment booking for patients
Enable patients to schedule routine visits directly through the web and mobile portal by configuring your scheduling rules. Only providers with active schedules and visit types marked as 'Online Eligible' will appear to patients.

1. Go to **Settings > Patient Portal > Booking Rules**.
2. Toggle on **Allow Online Appointment Booking**.
3. Navigate to **Scheduling > Visit Types**, select a visit type, and check the box for **Available Online**.
4. Under **Settings > Schedule > Provider Availability**, designate which staff members accept online requests.

**Limits & Conditions:**
Patients can only book appointments between 24 hours and 60 days in advance. Urgent visit types cannot be made available online.

**Troubleshooting:**
If a provider does not appear for booking, verify their schedule template is published and that their assigned rooms are active under **Settings > Facility > Rooms**.

Ticket:
Can't figure out how to stop patients from booking our procedure rooms online

I've spent an hour trying to restrict our online web booking so patients stop scheduling restricted visit types with the wrong doctors, but the settings just don't make sense. Why is it so difficult to limit certain appointment categories to specific providers? Please let us know how to fix this layout.

Auto-reply:
To prevent patients from booking procedure rooms online, go to **Scheduling > Visit Types**, select the procedure visit type(s), and clear the **Available Online** checkbox. Then, under **Settings > Schedule > Provider Availability**, make sure the providers who should not receive those online requests are not designated to accept online bookings. Only visit types marked as online‑eligible and providers with active, published schedules will appear to patients.

Source: Set up and manage online appointment booking for patients (configure-online-appointment-booking)
